description: This file defines the Migration class used for schema management and database migration tasks within the OpenX/Revive Adserver deployment system. It includes methods for copying tables, updating columns, logging, and resetting sequences, indicating its role in database schema upgrades.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class for managing database schema migrations, including copying tables, updating columns, logging, and resetting sequences, tailored for OpenX/Revive Adserver.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Migration object and sets up SQL statements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database connection and logging configuration.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Logs a message to the log file and message array.

methods.name: _logError
methods.description: Logs an error message to the log file and error array.

methods.name: _setupSQLStatements
methods.description: Sets up SQL query templates based on database syntax (MySQL or PostgreSQL).

methods.name: _putSqlStatement
methods.description: Stores a SQL statement template for a specific database syntax.

methods.name: _getQuotedTableName
methods.description: Returns a quoted and prefixed table name, handling errors.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the database table prefix from global configuration.

methods.name: _logErrorAndReturnFalse
methods.description: Logs an error and returns false.

methods.name: copyTableData
methods.description: Copies data from one table to another using a SQL insert statement.

methods.name: updateColumn
methods.description: Updates a column in one table with data from another table.

methods.name: afterAddTable
methods.description: Hook after adding a table, optionally copies data from a mapped table.

methods.name: afterAddField
methods.description: Hook after adding a field, optionally updates data from a mapped field.

methods.name: resetSequence
methods.description: Resets the sequence for a table's ID field on PostgreSQL to the current max value.
